Rounded top-edge rotary slot

The enclosure is generated from v8.3 OpenSCAD. The original CrowPanel rotary wheel is accessible through a rounded slot in the top end rather than a large hole through the front bezel. Board, battery, mic and motor are triangulations of imported STEP CAD; source dimensions are unchanged. Colors are added for readability.

Not production certified: component positions are an engineering trial and the exact driver circuit, connector access, acoustic seal, and button travel still need verification.

The downloadable CAD files remain editable in FreeCAD. This viewer is for rotating and inspecting them on a phone.
